title: Sitting ginger tabby cat with white bib
summary: A domestic ginger tabby cat sitting upright, facing forward, with a white chest, white muzzle, white front paws, greenish eyes, pink nose, and a ringed tail curled around the front.
observations: Single adult domestic cat shown in a seated pose, facing the camera.
Dominant coat is ginger-orange with darker tabby striping on the forehead, cheeks, front legs, body sides, and tail.
Large white bib covers the throat and chest, continuing down between the front legs; muzzle and front paws are also white.
Ears are tall, triangular, and upright with pale pink inner ears.
Tail is curled around the cat’s front/right side with visible darker orange bands.
Eyes are large and greenish-yellow with dark pupils; nose is small and pink.
